messages.text:
"Endless runner 3D cycling game through shuffling city/cycle paths and light trails, avoiding obstacles such cars, mommies with trolleys, curbs and drains, with choosing a bike type (road, gravel, hybrid, BMX, cruiser, MTB and such with it's advantages and disadvantages (handling, off-road stability...). Maybe some simpler tricks like hop or bunny hop for curbs and branches. Not very realistic graphics, but not too low-poly, a bit cartoony
"
